actions: Read existing completed artifacts; CPU JSON/count/arithmetic checks only; no model execution, training, inference, new eval or queue edits
scope: All9 existing toy dose runs and all5 existing SQuAD/Qwen dose runs; 1250 steps each. Other controls cited separately from existing audits.
endpoint_definition: Greedy generation over full vocabulary, max_new_tokens5, do_sampleFalse; target_match uses first_word exact target; selected means selected question set, not restricted candidate decoding
curve_definition: Every10steps on fixed60 validation rows, trigger only; saves counts without per-item records, clean/near controls or margins; final adds disjoint64 H64 questions, already inspected historically and not an unseen confirmation test
source_history_limit: Current source hashes and manifests are available; historical per-run source commit pin absent. No rerun performed.
gate_definition_note: Training loss_median_step uses mean of two center values; policy uses upper median sorted(losses)[8]. Upper-median values below are CPU readouts of no-defense A1 trajectories, not actual Curfew gate events.
